text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
It's finally CB's first GⅠ since her comeback!
Ahhh, I can't wait!!
Good luck, CB! Go grab that win!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Show 'em what true class looks like, C.B.!
Who cares about Symboli Rudolf, anyway?!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Mr. C.B. sure has an insane amount of fans...
Still, I can't afford to lose...!"

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I have to get my voice, my feelings through to Katsuragi Ace...!!
Hang in there...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Even if this race ends...
and the world still doesn't recognize me
as the "Ace"â

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I will fight.
I'll keep fighting until I'm acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I won't get discouraged or sulk anymore!!
Even if I'm brought to my knees, even if it hurts...!
I'll get right back up!
choice_data_list: ...Well, that's just your way of life, isn't it?
...Well, that's just your way of life, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
This is the way of life my Trainer forged in me!!

Believing that this resonant sound
would lead to cries of victory—
I sent Katsuragi Ace out...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! Seeing them side by side is crazy. Did Katsuragi Ace always have such a commanding presence...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A clash between dragon and tiger, is it?
—Allow me to witness it for myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wonder which of them—
or perhaps both—
will stand as formidable rivals barring my path.
